reviews.text: Пользовался бесплатной версией на Windows и всё было отлично, работал безукоризненно и я решил установить платную версию на все свои устройства. Я естественно не задумываясь решил приобрести тариф на месяц, а то и на год. После покупки тарифа на месяц начались мелкие зависания, но я не подумал что это то, чему стоило предавать значение, уже спустя дней 5 сервис прислал мне письмо с новой конфигурацией, я установил и её и после этого она проработала дня 3 на ПК и еле работает с постоянными перебоями на телефоне, на уровне бесплатного ВПН. Не советую пользоваться услугами данного сервиса, тем более за такие деньги.

reviews.title: Unable to use outside my house not even on my mobile data
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a Planet VPN subscription, but I am unable to use the service outside my home. When I am away from home, the Planet VPN app itself does not load properly, and I am not even able to log in to my VPN account.

The app only works normally when I am connected at home. I have tried using both mobile data and Wi-Fi outside my home, but I still cannot access the app or my account.

Because the service is not usable for me outside my home, I would like to request a full refund for my subscription.

Please let me know if you need any additional information regarding my purchase.

Thank you.

reviews.title: Scam! Free but selling your info /exposing you to scammers!
reviews.text:
Within a day of using this app for the first time, my inbox was flooded with spam emails. My phone has been ringing off the hook with scam calls and spam text messages and every single wave of those notices happened after using the VPN session. This app claims is safe secure and doesn’t track your data. This app is nothing but a scam.

Within 2 days of uninstalling this app all the scam calls spam emails stopped! They claim they don’t collect don’t sell? Then change their story to “we collect the bare minimum” and yet the facts are the facts! I started getting spam calls and emails night & day with 2 hrs of my first time using this app only visiting sites I’ve been to thousands of times without being harassed!

Within 2 days of removing this specific app and going to those sites not a single call or spam email.

This app developer can claim all they want it’s safe but can’t /wont explain why my spam filters saw a 300% increase in spam calls /emails while I had it installed.

Want more proof it’s sketchy? All the positive comments are in Russian and Chinese text. All the negative comments are from users in the USA Canada and the uk. Pretty obvious who controls this app and that it’s completely unsafe

reviews.title: Extremely Poor Service and Terrible Customer Support
reviews.text:
I have been paying for the premium subscription every month, but almost every month my subscription does not activate for several days. This time it has already been 5 days, and my premium access is still not activated.

This is not the first time. This issue happens almost every month, and the customer support is extremely slow and unhelpful. I keep sending emails and tickets, but nothing gets fixed on time.

Because of this problem, I am losing several days of my membership every month (sometimes nearly a week) even though I pay for the full monthly subscription. This is completely unfair.

Imagine paying for 30 days but only being able to use the service for 23–24 days because the company cannot activate the subscription properly.

For a paid service, this level of reliability is unacceptable. If you cannot maintain a proper subscription system or provide timely support, you should not be charging customers every month.

Until this issue is permanently fixed, I cannot recommend this VPN to anyone.

reviews.title: Deceptive subscription policy
reviews.text: The app worked reasonably well. Sometimes I would lose VPN connections - 2-3 times in a row with manual reconnects. After that it worked. The biggest problem I had is with its subscription policy deception. I initially had weekly subscription. I tested it to my satisfaction and then upgraded to full year subscription. It worked for a few days. Then 2 days ago  the app acted like I do not have a subscription. I could not access premium servers any more even though my iCloud account shows that I have a subscription. I filed a complaint. After sending few more emails the company asked me subscribe again hoping that Apple iOS will sort out my subscription. iOS just tried tagging on new subscription after end of current subscription. I decided to cancel annual subscription which isn’t working. I’ll use weekly subscription whenever I need it and then cancel promptly.
